title: Thai Black Bean Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious Thai-inspired bowl filled with crispy black beans, crunchy vegetables, and a tangy sauce.
instructions: Rinse the black beans and drain well.
In a medium pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the bean paste, fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes.
Add the sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked black beans to the pan and stir to combine.
Serve the mixture over the unique rice in the norwegian bowl.
Garnish with additional cabbage and chili flakes if desired.
